title: Residency, replica proof and the execution/data boundary
summary: A resident offer contains fabric/block/generation, logical peer, provider incarnation/owner epoch, aligned range and evidence identity. An evidence string is a lookup key, not its own proof.
invariants: Only the provider currently selected by MemoryFabricRegistry is the current block owner. Another provider can be admitted as a replica only via an independent trusted evidence verifier.
Do not send application block contents merely because named-service FIRST succeeded. Sender controls and receiver ingress must independently check identity, lease, authentication, and state.
Retain native shared/DMA block bags for local data access; remote access is a bounded verified transfer protocol requiring separate page integrity/commit receipt semantics.
Storage Fabric owns persistent backing and checkpoint/durable recovery; Memory Fabric owns volatile residency; Queue Fabric owns durable job control; Job-to-Node decides execution placement.

provenance.claim: Current provider, block generation and owner epoch validation.
Memory page boundary and lifecycle contracts.
